tips: Prioritize Reels over static images and basic breaking alerts; short video formats generate over 25x higher average reach (avg 601 vs ~20).
Focus science/tech and business content on tangible disruption and viral tech novelties (e.g., Microsoft outages, AI OS ports) which deliver the highest viewership.
Avoid routine sports session updates (e.g., cricket day/session reports) and general regional festivals, as they consistently register near-zero engagement.
Frame political and international stories around historic shifts or major diplomatic impact rather than hyper-local parliamentary commentary.
Target publishing windows between 16:00 and 20:00 UTC (peaking at 20:00 UTC with 1.64x score); avoid morning dead zones between 04:00 and 10:00 UTC.

news.summary: Aap ke page par sab se behtareen views English Reels se aa rahe hain, khaas tor par Business aur Tech topics par jo 16:00 se 20:00 UTC ke darmian post hotay hain. Dusri taraf static pictures aur simple breaking posts (khaas tor par Americas, routine cricket aur regional Asia news) bilkul zero reach de rahi hain. Is liye hum ne Business, Europe aur Tech ke content ko boost kiya hai aur low-performing topics ko kam kar diya hai taake reach aur monetization barh sake.

tips: Prioritize Reels and Match updates over static images (pics) and plain breaking news text, as dynamic match formats generate substantially higher views.
Write content in Urdu whenever possible, as Urdu posts consistently outperform English posts in reach and engagement.
Focus story angles on Combat Sports (Wrestling, MMA, Boxing) and Esports, using strong event-focused hooks.
Avoid spending effort on Golf, Cycling, Big Events, and Rugby, which currently get near-zero views.
Schedule primary posts during peak engagement windows (11:00-13:00 UTC and 16:00-20:00 UTC) while completely avoiding 04:00-10:00 UTC.
